summary: First iteration end-to-end test of SRM Elective Backup app (FastAPI + React). Backend: all 11 pytest tests pass (auth request/verify, submission lifecycle, faculty allocation, CSV/XLSX export, role guards). Frontend: landing modal → student dashboard → timer → prefs form → submission → faculty review → allocation → student accept flow all functional after fixing a critical infinite-render loop on FacultyDashboard (and preventive fix on StudentDashboard). Auth guards for /student/dashboard and /faculty/dashboard verified. CSV (1.3KB) and XLSX (5.8KB) exports contain header and rows. Testing performed with TIMER_MINUTES=0 (temporarily) and restored to 30.

ui_bugs.issue: Infinite render loop: `const session = getSession()` returned a new object every render, causing useEffect([refresh, session, nav]) to fire endlessly. Because refresh() calls setLoading(true) at start, table was stuck at 'Loading...' forever and API was being spammed with hundreds of /api/faculty/submissions requests per second. Applied minimal fix by memoizing session via useState(() => getSession()). Same latent bug also existed in StudentDashboard (didn't manifest visually because its refresh() doesn't reset loading, but still spammed API every render); patched same way.

action_items: Review the session-memoization fix applied to FacultyDashboard.jsx and StudentDashboard.jsx (changed `const session = getSession()` to `const [session] = useState(() => getSession())`). Consider a more robust pattern (e.g., an auth context/provider) so this class of bug can't recur across new pages.
Optionally, in dashboards, gate the auth-check useEffect by not including session in the dep array, or read session inside the effect.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth session read pattern (getSession()) is unstable across renders — every consumer that puts it in useEffect deps will loop. Recommend wrapping in React context or a stable hook that returns the same reference.
FacultyDashboard.refresh() sets loading=true on every poll/refresh; consider only setting loading on initial mount to avoid table flicker on filter changes.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown') — should migrate to lifespan handlers.

faculty_export builds a pandas DataFrame in-process for every request; fine at MVP scale, but no auth-level protection beyond role check (any faculty sees all submissions across all departments). Consider scoping by department.
TIMER_MINUTES is only read at process start; no way for staff to override for a given student without DB edit.

rca of the issue: Root cause of the faculty-dashboard-stuck-on-Loading bug: `getSession()` reads from localStorage and JSON.parses into a fresh object each call. Because it was called at the top of the component and then referenced as a dep in useEffect, each state update triggered a re-render → new session object → useEffect fires → refresh() called → setLoading(true) + setSubs → re-render → loop. Reproduction: open /faculty/dashboard while signed in as faculty and observe the Network tab flooded with /api/faculty/submissions calls; the table never leaves the 'Loading...' state. Mitigation applied: cache session in component state via `useState(() => getSession())` so the reference is stable. Long-term: introduce a proper Auth context provider.
